$comment: Copy to <project>/.opencode/team-dashboard.json (optional). mode: ask = the team asks once per run when a user is present (headless runs skip silently); always = start every run; never = off. refresh: seconds between regenerations; open_browser: open the dashboard in the default browser on start; coverage_ttl: seconds to cache a go-test coverage run (0 = off, default — a dashboard tick must not run tests / race the tester agent; failures cache at 5x ttl).
